body:
I received a single 20mg tab of Lexapro, so I ate it, duh.
While i was making my chicken pot pie about 45 minutes later it started to take affect.  The way I was feeling could be comparable to the onset of an acid trip; little giggles, weird thoughts and that un-describable feeling in my brain that those hamsters are chugging away.
My colleague came over about 3 hours later with a bottle of SoCo, and by this point I felt like a million bucks.  As I was sitting at my desk, my arm began to quiver.  Now this wasnt the first time it happened to me but it was more pronounced than in previous encounters.  We began to gang bang the bottle of liqour (5 Southern Comfort and Red Bulls) but my appetite for raging had subsided.  I was about 7 hours in to the dosing and felt like shit, probably from the drinking.
So after my friend left I proceeded to a usual tuesday night beat and pass, where I found that it was quite hard to become enticed by myself.
Throughout the night I tossed and turned because I kept waking up with cold sweats, and these continued throughout the next day also.  The next day also felt like the day after rolling, almost like Im missing all that serotonin that was supposed to be not reabsorbed.  BUt anyways, I would recommend not taking anti-depressants and alcohol at the same time.
